schema.description: HTTPS base URL for Klarna Payments. No fixed hostname allowlist is imposed. Examples only, not permitted-value restrictions: Europe production https://api.klarna.com/; North America production https://api-na.klarna.com/; Oceania production https://api-oc.klarna.com/; Europe playground https://api.playground.klarna.com/; North America playground https://api-na.playground.klarna.com/; Oceania playground https://api-oc.playground.klarna.com/. This configured destination can receive Klarna API credentials, so manage it only through authorized Business Configuration access.
schema.label: Klarna endpoint
schema.name: klarna_api_endpoint
